title: Define the seam between the drawing kit and decade's renderer
body:
`draw.rs` holds `Scene`, a display list of shapes in cells and pixels, beside `Paint`, which turns a scene into smithay GLES elements. `text.rs` rasterizes runs with swash and also uploads them as `GlesTexture`s through smithay's `ImportMem`. `Scene` imports `CellRect` from `panes.rs`, and `text.rs` imports `Settings`.

## Proposal

A `src/ui/` module holds `Scene`, its shapes, `CellRect`, `Rgba`, font loading, and rasterizing to CPU bitmaps. It imports nothing from smithay and nothing else from decade. decade's renderer keeps `Paint`, the texture upload and cache, and the font sizes taken from `Settings`. decade's own widgets stay outside `ui`.

A test reads the source under `src/ui/` and fails if any file names `smithay` or `crate::server`, so the seam is checked on every test run.

## Open

- whether `Face` sizes belong to the kit or stay with decade's settings
- whether the texture cache key moves with the rasterizer or stays with the upload
